notes.title: Magic Potion Destroyer Ver 1.02 Update
notes.content:
Dear fans,
 
Thank you for playing Magic Potion Destroyer. We have released the version 1.02 update with the following changes/fixes.
 
[b]【Details】[/b]
[list]
[*] Implemented in-game Achievements.
[*] Set the limit of MP recovery from Fortune to 9999.
[*] Set the limit for required MP for Mana Receptor and Power raiser to 1,000,000,000.
[*] Fixed an issue where the clear time for Ending 3 on HELL difficulty was not being shown on the Clear Record.
[*] Added ‘Battles Lost’ and ‘Stages Abandoned’ to the status display.
[*] Adjusted late game enemies to have less HP.
[*] Switched around the Chaos, Void and Demise enemy names to match with their weaknesses.
[*] Adjusted the Wave Speed Changer tutorial to occur earlier on.
[*] Various test fixes.
[/list]
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/676910/_/
 
---

(Japanese Only)
Cyberpunk Bartender Action N1RV Ann-A (pronounced simply as Nirvana) is a booze em' up about waifus, technology, and life in the dystopian economic bubble.
Coming soon to PC, Nintendo Switch (JP), PlayStation 4 (JP)

You are a bartender at VA-11 HALL-A, affectionately nicknamed "Valhalla." Although it is just a small bar downtown, it attracts the most fascinating people this side of dystopia. Keep your clients lubricated and you will be made privy to the most interesting stories.

(Japanese Only)
College dropout Mae Borowski returns home to the crumbling former mining town of Possum Springs seeking to resume her aimless former life and reconnect with the friends she left behind. But things aren't the same. Home seems different now and her friends have grown and changed. Leaves are falling and the wind is growing colder. Strange things are happening as the light fades.
Coming soon to PC (JP), Nintendo Switch (JP), PlayStation 4 (JP), Xbox One (JP)
[b]Currently on show at TGS @ Hall 9 Indie Game Corner 9-B43[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/481510/Night_in_the_Woods/


[h1]Astebreed[/h1]
Climb into the cockpit of an otherworldly war machine and fly into battle against a horrifying alien race bent on eradicating humanity to preserve their own civilization.
Coming soon to Nintendo Switch. 


[h1]Croixleur Sigma[/h1]
Wielding magic blades, four girls fight back successive waves of monsters in this exhilarating hack-and-slash action game!
Coming soon to Nintendo Switch. 


[h1]Will -A Wonderful World-[/h1]
(Japanese Only)
A young girl wakes up, groggy in an unknown room. A talking dog appears before her and she becomes startled by the revelation he tells her: They are gods and it is their duty to change the fate of any humans that ask for their help. Letters appear in the mail and with pen in hand she begins her job.
Coming soon to Nintendo Switch (JP) and PlayStation 4 (JP)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/588040/WILL_A_Wonderful_World__WILL/


[h1]La-Mulana 2 OST[/h1]
The Original Soundtrack for La-Mulana 2 has now been released! Relive the ruins with 59 tracks! 
[b]Currently on show at TGS @ Hall 5, Konami Booth[/b]

notes.title: Update - Ver 1.01
notes.content:
Hi All!

Today we have updated Magic Potion Destroyer to fix some issues and change some settings. 
You can find the details of the update below: 

[h1] Ver 1.01 Update Details[/h1] 
[list]
[*]Config "Autosave before each stage?" set to on as a default (No save right after the new game)
[*]Config "Don't reset the WAVE speed after each stage" set to on as a default
[*]High speed battle will be disabled during the boss battle
[*]Boss warning happens more often in Stage 30
[*]Text fixes[/list]

We hope that you will all continue supporting Magic Potion Destroyer. 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/676910/Magic_Potion_Destroyer/
